name: ziex
description: Ziex - full-stack web framework for Zig

ziex.lsp.enableSnippets.markdownDescription: Enable snippet completions. Falls back to `zig.zls.enableSnippets` when not set.

ziex.lsp.enableArgumentPlaceholders.markdownDescription: Enable function argument placeholder completions. Falls back to `zig.zls.enableArgumentPlaceholders` when not set.

ziex.lsp.completionLabelDetails.markdownDescription: Show the function signature in completion results. Falls back to `zig.zls.completionLabelDetails` when not set.

ziex.lsp.semanticTokens.markdownDescription: Level of semantic tokens. `partial` only includes information that requires semantic analysis. Falls back to `zig.zls.semanticTokens` when not set.

ziex.lsp.inlayHintsShowVariableTypeHints.markdownDescription: Show inlay hints for variable types. Falls back to `zig.zls.inlayHintsShowVariableTypeHints` when not set.

ziex.lsp.inlayHintsShowStructLiteralFiel.markdownDescription: Show inlay hints for fields in struct and union literals. Off by default in Ziex. Falls back to `zig.zls.inlayHintsShowStructLiteralFieldType` when not set.

ziex.lsp.inlayHintsShowParameterName.markdownDescription: Show inlay hints for parameter names. Falls back to `zig.zls.inlayHintsShowParameterName` when not set.

ziex.lsp.inlayHintsShowBuiltin.markdownDescription: Show inlay hints for builtin functions. Off by default in Ziex. Falls back to `zig.zls.inlayHintsShowBuiltin` when not set.

ziex.lsp.inlayHintsExcludeSingleArgument.markdownDescription: Hide parameter name hints for single-argument calls. Falls back to `zig.zls.inlayHintsExcludeSingleArgument` when not set.

ziex.lsp.inlayHintsHideRedundantParamNam.markdownDescription: Hide parameter name hints when the argument is the same identifier (`foo: foo`). On by default in Ziex. Falls back to `zig.zls.inlayHintsHideRedundantParamNames` when not set.

Hide parameter name hints when the argument ends with the same identifier (`foo: bar.foo`, `foo: &foo`). On by default in Ziex. Falls back to `zig.zls.inlayHintsHideRedundantParamNamesLastToken` when not set.

ziex.lsp.builtinPath.markdownDescription: Override the path to the `builtin` module. Resolved automatically when unset. Falls back to `zig.zls.builtinPath` when not set.

ziex.lsp.zigLibPath.markdownDescription: Override the Zig library path. Resolved from the Zig executable when unset. Falls back to `zig.libPath` when not set.

ziex.lsp.globalCachePath.markdownDescription: Directory used as the ZLS cache. Falls back to `zig.zls.globalCachePath` when not set.

ziex.lsp.additionalOptions.markdownDescription: Extra [ZLS options](https://github.com/zigtools/zls/blob/master/src/Config.zig) passed as is, using ZLS names (`snake_case`). Settings above take precedence. Options set in `zig.zls.additionalOptions` are used as a fallback.
